Best beginner tips and tricks for War of Genesis: Idle Loot
Best beginner tips and tricks for War of Genesis: Idle Loot
By
Mohammad Sadiq
Modified Sep 16, 2026 15:36 GMT 
Discuss
Tips and tricks for War of Genesis: Idle Loot (Image via New Normal Soft Inc.)

War of Genesis: Idle Loot is far from a beginner-friendly game at first glance. There are a ton of characters to unlock, mechanics to juggle, and menus to sift through. This can make your early hours in the game incredibly frustrating, which is why we're here to help.

Ad

In this guide, we shall go over the best beginner tips and tricks to help you in the early hours of War of Genesis: Idle Loot. If you're just starting with the game, the tips we offer will help you earn currency consistently, while also ensuring that you're keeping up with the game's challenge.

Beginner tips to help you in War of Genesis: Idle Loot
Starting character
Ad
MUST READS
War of Genesis: Idle Loot has multiple characters (Image via New Normal Soft Inc.)

War of Genesis: Idle Loot lets you pick from three different classes, each with its own set of characters on offer. As a starting experience, we recommend using the Ranger class, as it hits hard and fast without putting you at risk. It is also one of the best classes for farming due to its DPS potential, allowing you to have a smooth progression curve.

Ad

As you play the Ranger and level up, we then recommend unlocking characters in this class. There’s a new character every 10 levels or so, and it provides a significant buff in stats. Unlock the characters as you meet their requirements to keep up with the game’s challenge.

The Equipment Blacksmith is simple

As you hover over the Equipment Blacksmith menu, you’ll be bombarded with several tabs. Your first instinct may be to ignore the feature entirely, but do not do so. The first feature under this Blacksmith is the “Combine” tab. You’ll see several slots here which help you craft. You don’t have to manually engage with them. Simply click on “Auto-Register,” and the game will pull the items from your inventory directly. Then, click on Combine to transform these resources into loot.

Ad

The second tab is the “Dismantle” tab. Here, you can take the loot you don’t need and break it to acquire the elements inside. Don’t use Auto-Register for dismantling. Manually pick the items you don’t need and place them into the Dismantle slots.

The final tab is the “Jewel” tab, where you can affix Jewels to your gear. Place the Jewel you want to use in the second slot and the weapon or gear item you want to affix it to in the first slot. Then, select “Equip” to combine the two.

Ad
Manage the currencies
Earn money in War of Genesis: Idle Loot (Image via New Normal Soft Inc.)

Play through the game, and you’ll no doubt pick up several Gold Bars and Diamond Pouches. These items, by themselves, are fairly useless. To make use of them, you need to head to the Refinery Blacksmith.

Ad

Enter the Refinery Blacksmith, and you’ll see two slots. Place the item in the left slot, and the right slot will show you what it yields. You can convert your Gold Bars to Gold Coins, which are the main currency in the game. You can also convert your Diamond Pouches into Diamonds, which are a premium currency.

Engage with the Marketplace

The Marketplace is yet another fast way to earn money in War of Genesis: Idle Loot. The game’s Marketplace is integrated with Steam directly. Access the market using your inventory, and you’ll then be able to list items for sale. We recommend using this feature as much as possible.

Ad

However, be mindful that listing items costs you 1x Diamond. So you want to list as many items as you can in one batch. Simply listing one single item is a waste of a Diamond.
